lines.text: Monday, your agent hit a trap. Tuesday. Same trap.
Agent notebook gives it a page of lessons.
One plain text file. One lesson per line.
When a task starts, your harness shows it that file. When it ends, the agent votes on what helped.
The file is capped. A new lesson always gets in. The lowest score drops out.
Because the one that matters most, is the one your agent would never think to search for.
lines.caption: Because the one that matters most is the one your agent would never think to search for.

lines.text: And it's plain text. You can read it, fix it, and review every change.
It's a store, not a loop. Your harness drives it.
Thursday, it reads the note first.
Agent notebook. Small memory, on purpose.
